name: packet-scaling-2025-v1

G1_no_fixed_bps_component.rationale: A significantly positive intercept would mean a spread-independent component exists, so a tight-spread name could clear the cost. This is the economic claim under test.

G2_scaling_is_real.rationale: The markout must actually scale with the half-spread rather than be unrelated noise.

G3_none_clear_cost.statistic: share of names with mean markout > 2 x mean half-spread
G3_none_clear_cost.rationale: The tradeability claim. Allows a 1% tolerance rather than requiring exactly zero out of sample.

G4_no_formation_circularity.statistic: abs(run3 mk3_t0 - clust3 mk3_t0) panel level, bps
G4_no_formation_circularity.rationale: Sign-conditioned and timing-only formation must continue to agree. Divergence would mean the law is a construction artifact in 2025 even though it was not in 2023-24.

G5_slope_transports.rationale: The law must reproduce quantitatively, not merely in sign, on a year never used.

decision_rule: All five gates pass -> VERIFIED_RESULTS 1.21 is promoted to out-of-sample confirmed and becomes the paper's spine. Any gate fails -> record the failure verbatim, do not re-specify, do not tune, and do not build the paper on the law.
prohibited: inspecting 2025 outputs before the gate is applied
changing definitions, horizons, filters or the gate after seeing 2025
re-running with different parameters to obtain a pass
